style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: swabhavajam, born of nature, means work fits the person
krishigaurakshyavaniijyam, farming, cattle-keeping, and trade, is the work of the merchant class
candidates.evidence: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म (Farming, cattle-keeping, and trade are the work of the merchant class)

candidates.angle: paricharyatmakam, service-oriented, is the work of the shudra
candidates.evidence: परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि (Service to others is the work of the shudra also)

en.intro: The Gita has described the duties of warriors, teachers, and rulers. Now it names the work of merchants and service workers, showing how society holds together.
en.notice: The word swabhavajam means born of nature. It tells us that farming, cattle-keeping, trade, and service are not random jobs, but duties that belong to particular people by their very nature.
en.next: A person devoted to their own work attains perfection. Krishna now explains how that devotion leads to perfection.
en.meaning: Farming, cattle-keeping, and trade are the natural work of the merchant class. Service to others is the natural work of the worker class.

hi.intro: गीता में योद्धाओं, शिक्षकों और शासकों के कर्तव्यों का वर्णन हुआ है। अब इसमें व्यापारियों और सेवा करने वालों के काम बताए गए हैं, जो समाज को जोड़े रखते हैं।
hi.meaning: कृषि, गो-रक्षा और वाणिज्य ये सब वैश्य के स्वाभाविक कर्म हैं, तथा दूसरों की सेवा करना शूद्र का भी स्वाभाविक कर्म है।
hi.next: जो अपने कर्म में लगा रहता है, वह पूर्णता को प्राप्त होता है। कृष्ण अब समझाते हैं कि अपने कर्म में लगे रहने से वह पूर्णता कैसे मिलती है।
